cards.headline: Mbappé’s brace ends Barça’s perfect La Liga start in a 2-1 Clásico defeat
cards.summary: Kylian Mbappé scored twice as Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday. Raphinha equalised after the break but Mbappé’s late winner ended Barça’s nine-game winning run in the league. The result leaves Barça top with 27 points, three clear of Madrid.
cards.body: The first Clásico of the 2026/27 season finished 1-2 to the visitors. Mbappé opened the scoring in the 41st minute when Gerard Martín’s clearance rebounded off him and into the net. Raphinha levelled in the 61st minute after a Pedri pass. Eduardo Camavinga then set up Mbappé for the 87th-minute winner. Joan Garcia made several saves. Espart left injured at half-time and Balde replaced him. De Jong came on for Fermín in the 74th minute. Flick’s side had 18 shots to Madrid’s 10 but lost. The defeat followed the midweek 4-2 loss to PSG. Barça remain first on 27 points from 10 games. Atletico sit second and Madrid third on 24. Kick-off was 21:00. Martínez Munuera refereed. Reuters and club accounts confirmed the scoreline and scorers. Mbappé finished with 11 league goals. Lunin made key saves including one from Gordon. Yamal had a chance before the interval that went wide. The side finished with Cancelo, Cubarsí, Martín and Balde across the back line after the early change. Pedri and Rodri controlled the midfield for long spells. The result was Madrid’s first win at Camp Nou in the league under the current Mourinho spell. Club channels updated the score live. The referee was Martínez Munuera of the Valencian committee. Barça’s perfect start of nine straight league wins ended on the same ground where they had sealed the previous title.

cards.headline: Club confirms Espart out for seven weeks with syndesmosis ankle injury
cards.summary: Barcelona’s medical report on Monday confirmed Xavi Espart suffered a right ankle syndesmosis injury in the Clásico. The 19-year-old will be out for approximately seven weeks after a collision with Tchouaméni. Balde replaced him at half-time and is expected to start at Alavés.
cards.body: Tests at the Ciutat Esportiva on Monday showed damage to the syndesmosis joint. Espart, who started at right-back, felt the injury early and asked to come off around the 29th minute. He had already carried discomfort after the PSG match. The club statement said the injury came from a traumatic action with an opposing player. Estimated recovery is seven weeks, which would keep him out until mid-December. He misses Alavés, Atlético and the Aston Villa Champions League fixture. Koundé, Eric García and Christensen remain unavailable. Cancelo, Balde, Cubarsí and Gerard Martín are the available senior defenders. MARCA and La Vanguardia reported the diagnosis and the club’s pointing to the challenge. Official Spanish and English accounts posted the medical bulletin. Espart had signed a new contract until 30 June 2030 only days earlier. He scored on his full Champions League debut against PSG and started the Clásico at right-back. The collision occurred early and he lasted until the half-hour mark. Recovery will include the international break. Return is targeted for mid-December at the earliest. The club statement appeared on both language accounts. Media in Spain noted the already thin defensive options. Balde, who had limited minutes this season, is the immediate beneficiary. Cancelo can cover either flank. The next three matches will be played without the 19-year-old.
